evidence_source: Consensus academic-paper search and fetched paper records
claim_boundary: validates method choice and risk controls, not local extraction output correctness or aviation operational correctness
overall_verdict: The extraction method matrix is supported at the method-selection level. Deterministic translators, ontology validation, and layout-aware document extraction are strongly supported. LLM event extraction is supported only with evidence, schema, and human-review gates.

method_validations.project_control: Generate a NASA ATMONTO profile and SHACL/domain-range checks before accepting triples.
Keep source fields, raw strings, checksums, parser version, and deterministic mapping rules.
Parse NASR members with file-specific parsers and attach effective-cycle metadata to each record.
Require exact quote evidence, ATMONTO allowed terms, domain/range validation, timestamp review, and human review before gold use.
Keep hybrid Docling plus PyMuPDF: Docling for structure, PyMuPDF for text-fidelity fallback.
Use schema dictionaries, type conversion, key normalization, and explicit mapping files.
Keep OpenSky/trajectory work optional and separate from primary claims. Validate time, coordinate sanity, and provenance.
Use papers for citations, source links, and design rationale only. Do not convert literature claims into event facts.

source_specific_implications.note: ATM ontology alignment work reports conceptual mismatches and manual reference alignment, supporting AIRM-O as audit/reference rather than replacement ground truth.
Stable fields and cycle-valid archives should be mapped deterministically into ontology-aligned records.
Text-rich advisories are a valid LLM extraction target, but event schemas, evidence grounding, and review are required.
Layout-aware parsing plus text-fidelity fallback is supported; parser selection should remain task-specific.
